review.why: Implements and troubleshoots Cloudflare Email Sending and Email Routing: prerequisites, binding setup, REST use, receiving mail and deliverability.
review.summary: Tells the agent to trust current docs over its memory, then checks prerequisites (domain onboarded, send binding configured, mail parser installed). A table routes to sending from a Worker, from an agent, from an external app by REST, from a coding agent, receiving mail and improving deliverability. It lists common mistakes such as a missing binding or unverified domain.
strengths: Prerequisite checks before writing any email code
Prefers the Workers binding, which needs no API key
cautions: Enabling a domain changes the user's account
Six reference files are not read here
